The Elven steed recovers Wind character fatigue. Any time damage the Elven steed suffers Wind fatigue, it may recover Wind the same way the owner character does. The Elven steed recovers Han or loses Ride instead of Resilience. It also Enemies may attack it as an action, causing it to lose 1 Wind automatically. When the Elven steed runs out of Wind, it becomes Blown and is in danger of dying. Any new mount. If your Elven steed would lose Wind while Blown, instead make an Average (2d) Ride (Ag) check, Handle Animal (2d) check, or your horse makes an Average (2d) Strength check. Open Advances: If you fail the test, your Elven steed loses 1 Wind. You may purchase a permanent +1 maximum Wind for your Elven steed for 8 career advances. The Elven steed is Swift and Fast, it gets a free movement manoeuvre on its turn in addition to the normal movement manoeuvre. You may purchase an extra Trick talent for your Elven steed once during your career as 1 career advance; the talent applies both to you and the mount. The Elven steed acts the talent refers to Obedience.
